en-US.tooltip: Configuration for the Wayke vehicle inventory data feed.
The Wayke/cloud endpoint URL that returns the dealer's vehicle inventory as a JSON array.
Authentication token for the Wayke API. Provided by Volvo.

Wayke branch name(s) whose vehicles this screen shows, comma-separated for several. Must match the Wayke branch name exactly. Leave empty and the screen shows no vehicles at all — a screen may only ever show its own dealership's inventory, so nothing is shown until this or the Dealer ID is set. Overridden by Dealer ID and by the player's own BRANCH_NAMES setting.
Enable the multi-brand filter and 'Alla märken' button. Set to true for multi-brand dealerships.

Dealership names to be filtered in the way they are displayed. Format: Keyword|Pattern|Replace With 
Spaces are included in formatting
Settings to be used as fallbacks when no settings can be found.

Wayke ID(s) used to load the vehicle inventory, comma-separated for several. Accepts either a showroom ID or a whole dealer organisation ID — an organisation ID loads every showroom belonging to that dealer. Takes priority over Branch Name; leave empty to select the inventory by branch name instead. The player's own DEALER_ID setting, when present, overrides this one.
Annual interest rate used as a fallback for the finance calculator if the vehicle record does not include one. Example: 7.95
Configuration for the kiosk interaction analytics.

Seconds of inactivity before the current analytics session is closed. The next touch on the screen starts a new session, so each visitor is measured separately. Set to 0 to disable idle sessions (one session per player restart). Example: 180
